messages:
olivia: Quick Q — my partner's kid is turning 22, an international student on F-1, will be here for the summer and fall. Can I add them to my medical/dental mid-year? Open enrollment is closed.

people-ops: Hi @olivia 8 short version: stepchildren can be dependents if they meet the age cutoff (under 26) and relationship proof is provided. Being on an F-1 doesn't automatically disqualify them. Mid-year additions require a QLE or an eligibility exception.

olivia: They were born abroad, no SSN yet. Is the I-20 + passport + university enrollment letter adequate? Also the custodial parent is my partner but custody docs are a bit informal (not a formal court order).

jamal: I-20 + passport + current full-time enrollment letter are the primary docs for student status. For relationship/custody: if you don't have a formal court custody order, we accept a combination of documents e.g., partner's birth certificate listing child, a signed notarized statement from the custodial parent, or a guardianship letter. Attach whatever you have and we'll route for manual review.

people-ops: Process notes: 1) Upload documents via the secure intake link below and use the filename convention so payroll/carrier routing works. 2) If the dependent moved to the US or gained full-time student status recently, that can be a QLE with a 30 enrollment window. Include dates for the move/enrollment. 3) If no QLE applies, coverage will start at the next open enrollment.

benefits-bot: Upload link: https://benefits.redwood.com/upload  choose category: dependent_enrollment. Allowed files: pdf, jpg, png. Filename example provided after this message.

hr-intake: Filename convention (helps automation):
```
lastname_firstname_doc_YYYYMMDD.pdf
example: chen_li_i20_20260815.pdf
```

olivia: Thanks. One more: dental/vision need separate forms or same upload? And how long until payroll reflects deductions?

people-ops: Use the same upload for medical+dental+vision; indicate in the upload notes which plans you want added. Payroll typically picks up changes the first full pay period after carrier confirms enrollment  usually 1-2 pay cycles. We'll tag payroll once processed.

olivia: Uploading now (I have I-20, passport scan, university enrollment letter, partner's passport + a signed notarized parent statement). Will comment here with move/enrollment dates. Thanks! :pray:

benefits-bot: Upload received: chen_li_i20_20260815.pdf. Intake ticket #B-2026-413 created. Estimated review 1-3 business days. We'll update this thread when the carrier responds. :white_check_mark:
